title: Enforce production release required checks
goal: Require a clean install, green tests, deterministic build, security gates, and matching-SHA deployed E2E before main can promote to production
acceptance_criteria: The current three Vitest failures, two Jest configuration failures, and production build/typecheck stall are resolved
QA-003 passes against the exact staging release SHA with no accidental skips
Main branch protection requires clean install, lint, typecheck, unit/integration tests, production build, migration checks, service-role audit, security scan, and critical E2E
Pull requests and main pushes run the required checks and a failed or missing check cannot deploy production
The final go/no-go record links the release SHA, CI and E2E runs, deployment IDs, migration evidence, approver, and rollback point

evidence: Read-only source preflight at SHA 7cf660ad8422dbd3adbdb77369d94638cdc2231b: full Vitest is not green (5017 passed, 8 skipped, 2 failed across 535 files).
The two failures are __tests__/integrations/mfa.service.test.ts backup-code bcrypt timeout and __tests__/logistics/site-map-ops-upgrade.test.ts expecting PublicSiteMapViewer.
Hosted E2E workflow has no run for candidate SHA 7cf660ad8422dbd3adbdb77369d94638cdc2231b; the latest 20 listed runs failed, including run 33990768961 failing both Vitest and Playwright jobs.
Candidate SHA check-runs contain no E2E result; source e2e.yml remains pull_request/manual-only and the hosted workflow cannot prove a post-merge main deployment SHA.
GET /repos/KyleQD/Tourify/branches/main/protection returned 404: main is not branch-protected and no required-check enforcement evidence exists.
npm run agents:validate passed: 17 agents, 99 tasks, 0 warnings, 0 errors; changed-path diff check passed. No workflow, deployment, or branch-protection changes were made.

progress.summary: Production-readiness audit promoted RELEASE-005 to P0. The current gate is three Vitest failures, two Jest configuration failures, deterministic build/typecheck completion, QA-003 matching-SHA certification, branch protection, and release evidence; the stale 27-failure wording is retired.
next_steps: Resolve the MFA bcrypt timeout and PublicSiteMapViewer test failures, then rerun the full Vitest suite on a clean candidate SHA.
Obtain a successful hosted E2E run for the exact candidate SHA after the workflow's post-merge/matching-SHA contract is satisfied.
Have the repository owner provision branch protection on main and record e2e.yml as a required check; do not change this from the local task.
Re-run the preflight and close RELEASE-005 only with hosted enforcement evidence.
blockers: Full Vitest baseline is not green: two failures remain.
No matching-SHA hosted E2E result exists; the latest listed hosted runs failed.
main is not branch-protected (GitHub API returned 404), so required-check enforcement is unverified.
